name: Platform-Neutral Procurement Language
consequences: Incorporating platform-neutrality into AltID procurement language stabilizes the Danish digital identity architecture, but may not immediately alter existing supplier relationships or app-store dominance.
options: Embed platform-neutral requirements within AltID procurement documents to ensure future-proofing and resilience.
Introduce a phased approach for incorporating platform-neutral components into existing MitID infrastructure, allowing for incremental upgrades and minimizing disruption.
Develop a comprehensive vendor-neutral standards framework that prioritizes open authentication protocols and fallback access mechanisms, promoting long-term digital sovereignty.
review: Embedding platform-neutral requirements within procurement documents may not directly challenge the market dominance of Apple and Google, but rather reinforces their existing position as trusted providers while ensuring future-proofing for Danish digital identity. The gap this approach leaves unaddressed is the potential for these suppliers to continue dictating terms and conditions without meaningful competition or oversight.

options: Create a set of guidelines and best practices for implementing FIDO2/WebAuthn and OpenID Connect on GrapheneOS or comparable platforms, serving as a blueprint for future digital identity initiatives.
